show.description: Years ago, little Krish was thrown out of Rampur as “unlucky,” shattering his parents’ hearts. Fate had other plans. After 18 years, he returns as Karan Singhania: a rich, powerful man and the unexpected son-in-law of their adopted daughter, Priya. The village that once rejected him now bows in respect, unaware of his truth. As secrets surface, old wounds reopen, relationships crumble, and pride is tested. This is not a story of revenge, but of justice, identity, and a son finally coming home.
